messages.subject: scale_continuous limits
parts:
I´m using facet and always want the y-axis to start at 0, but not have
to specify the maximum scale value, e.g.

ggplot(rbind(data.frame(x=1:10,y=rnorm(10)+100,
group=1),data.frame(x=1:10,y=rnorm(10)+150, group=2))) +
geom_point(aes(x,y)) + facet_wrap(~group)

ny adding something like

+ scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,NA))

Is there an easy way to do this?

Thanks Laurie
